shortDescription: RNS Number : 9367T  Energean PLC  09 September 2026   Energean plc("Energean" or the "Company")2Q 2026 Interim Dividend DeclarationLondon, 9 September 2026 - Energean plc (LSE: ENOG, TASE: אנאג) announces that the Board has declared an interim dividend in respect of 2Q 2026 of 10 US cents per share…

children: London, 9 September 2026 - Energean plc (LSE: ENOG, TASE: אנאג) announces that the Board has declared an interim dividend in respect of 2Q 2026 of 10 US cents per share.
